source_caption_text:
Pusha T snapped on this new song with Fat Joe and Dre 😮‍💨🔥

“Set Of Keys” is one of those tracks where Pusha T comes in sounding completely unimpressed by everyone else’s lifestyle. His delivery is calm and controlled, but every line carries the feeling that he is looking down on anyone who cannot match his level of wealth.

He references 100-carat sleeves, custom YSL bags and 2027 Rolls-Royce engines as if they are completely ordinary. What makes the verse stand out is how effortlessly he delivers those lines. He never sounds like he is trying too hard to flex, which somehow makes the luxury talk hit even harder.

Fat Joe and Dre set the tone for the track, but Pusha T ultimately steals the spotlight with his verse. The combination of his laid-back delivery, sharp writing and confident presence makes the performance one of the track’s biggest highlights. 

#pushat #fatjoe #hiphop
